note: MG-04 reviewed allow-list. Every Muster-vs-Planner-golden diff the parity suite tolerates is listed here with the backlog item (MG-xx), decision (D1) or intended difference that owns it, and the exact number of diffs it absorbs per fixture (both producers together). First matching entry in file order wins. The suite fails on any diff no entry absorbs, and on any entry whose absorbed count differs from its count, so when an MG item lands its counts drop and the entry must be shrunk or removed. Producers: 'session' = Muster end to end from the fixture session; 'chain' = Muster's vendored compile fed Planner's own inputs. Review the current numbers with `npm run fixtures:generate -- --parity-report`.
